title: Big events call for big marketing stunts. It hurts but bravo uber 👏
description: Big events call for big marketing stunts. It hurts but bravo uber 👏
transcript: Uber just won the World Cup. Well, if there was a marketing version, they certainly have. It's playful, it's built to get people sharing pictures of it, perfectly timed and the offer is great. Fans have been saying how expensive transport has been in New York during the World Cup. A 30% off code. Perfect 10 out of 10. Uber, well played.
